title: EVER ADVANCED Padded Camping Chair — High Backrest, up to 150 kg
short_description: Padded folding camping chair with high backrest, armrests, side pocket and cup holder. Supports up to 150 kg, carry bag included — for camping, garden, balcony and fishing.
long_description: The EVER ADVANCED camping chair (model FC-99806) is a padded folding chair with a high backrest. It measures 88 x 60 x 109.2 cm and supports up to 150 kg. The frame is powder-coated steel (17 mm), the cover 100% polyester. Armrests, a side pocket and a cup holder make it practical for long evenings at the tent. Folded, it measures 21.6 x 21.6 x 104.1 cm and weighs 3.9 kg; a carry bag is included. Suitable for camping, garden, balcony, beach and fishing.
buying_angle: Practical for campers and anglers who want a comfortable, padded folding chair with a high backrest and cup holder.
